blind.description: A medieval siege boiling oil cauldron mounted on an A-frame wooden support stand. The frame consists of light brown wooden beams reinforced with dark grey iron brackets and corner fittings. Centrally suspended on a pivoting axle is a spherical dark cast-iron cauldron filled with murky yellowish-green bubbling oil. Extending backwards from the pivot on one side is an iron lever handle for tipping the pot. Beneath the cauldron sits a square metal fire tray filled with coal and firewood embers. All surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with stylized game-art textures.
blind.from_above: Seen from above, it shows a rectangular wooden base frame enclosing a circular dark iron pot filled with greenish liquid with small bubbles. A straight lever handle extends out to the lower-left, and an iron bracket mechanism anchors either side of the pot to the upright posts.
blind.height_vs_figure: The wooden frame reaches about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 ft tall), with the tilted lever extending slightly higher; the base is roughly 3 ft wide and 2.5 ft deep.

notes: Height is somewhat squatter than catalog ratio (1.0 vs 1.5), but reads clearly as the intended siege cauldron
